column2: In the war among gods known as the $$創世記戦争$$, seven $$大邪神$$s were said to have died...
Their souls, now but corpses, are said to dwell within the armor still, even as they decay...
And to grant the very power of the gods to whoever possesses it...
The $$欲望$$ one believes in...
Even if none of them can be seen, even if they are uncertain things...
People sometimes sacrifice everything to pursue them...
Even if what they seek is...
a cursed thing that endlessly drinks $$生き血$$...
even if it is $$生きた鎧$$ that takes the life of its wearer...
